title: Release update preview / main-city relic / battle result / non-blocking drawers follow-up

requirements.requirement: DEV update preview must not show a fake immediately-update action; preview remains non-reloading and uses a clear close-preview action.
Main-city team relic block must be fully scrollable above the fixed bottom navigation using the actual final-content owner and safe-area/nav reserve.
Boss/Abyss battle result details must use a substantially larger mobile-readable panel in the 1080-wide app coordinate system.
Battle statistics and Boss mechanism drawers must not pause auto/manual battle; no blocking scrim or drawer pause lock may remain.
Skill VFX must render above both drawers; the left battle-status entry stays attached to the left edge, is vertically draggable, and remains below battle action controls.
